title: The Divine Orchestration and Purpose of the People You Encounter
body:
IUIC in the ClassRoom · 2026-03-15

Opens [Rom 13](/bible/romans/13) · [Rev 17](/bible/revelation/17) · [Rev 12](/bible/revelation/12) · [2 Cor 10](/bible/2-corinthians/10) · [Isa 46](/bible/isaiah/46) · [Sir 26](/bible/sirach/26) · [Eccl 7](/bible/ecclesiastes/7) · [Exod 34](/bible/exodus/34) · [1 Cor 10](/bible/1-corinthians/10) · [Jer 1](/bible/jeremiah/1) · [2 Esdras 7](/bible/2-esdras/7)
## Introduction *[[7:42](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRCyPWIqvlE&t=462s)]* A Sabbath class from one of the New York bishops that opens with a prelude, the war today is not just on TV, and then teaches The Divine Orchestration and Purpose of the People You Encounter. The prelude warns that prophecy should move us to correction, not entertain us, and reads Revelation 17 on Babylon the Great while pressing that the real war is the spiritual one inside each of us. The lesson proper: God declares the end from the beginning, so the people who betray, entrap, and vex you were sent to reflect what is still in you. A wicked woman is given to a wicked man; the same spirits follow you to the next town or congregation until you learn; and the narrow passage of 2 Esdras 7 is your own lusts, doubts, and fears, which you must overcome before the kingdom. ## In The News - *[[12:25](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRCyPWIqvlE&t=745s)]* **An NBC report: Trump says the war is very complete, Iran has no navy, communications, or air force, and it will be a short excursion. Iran names the assassinated Ayatollah's son as supreme leader, a hardliner with fewer religious credentials, and Trump calls the choice a big mistake. The Iranian women's soccer team refuses to sing the anthem in Australia and five are granted asylum. Iran hits Saudi, Kuwaiti, and Bahraini targets and both sides now strike oil.** — Watch as well as pray, but many are glued to the bombs overseas while their own spirits are rotten. Telling another nation who to put in office is nearly what they did illegally in Panama; the soccer team is propaganda to drown out the people who elected him. The war is about oil, which is why Washington was unhappy that Israel made oil a target, and Iran is driving the price up to pressure a ceasefire. - *[[1:09:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRCyPWIqvlE&t=4184s)]* **A young woman who enlisted for a signing bonus after failing to find work is now crying to get out because she may be sent to the Iran theater, and cannot leave without facing military law.** — A ranking brother in the body re-enlisted after the war was announced, going against the prophecy he is supposed to know. Someone in the world is trying to escape what a brother in purple and gold is volunteering for. Recruiting stations sit in black cities like Planned Parenthood: be all you can never be in America. If you go, you will be in the armies that gather against Christ. - *[[1:14:29](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRCyPWIqvlE&t=4469s)]* **A woman in her car describes a Black Hebrew Israelite in downtown Houston asking whether she has a boyfriend; she answers Jesus, he keeps pressing for her number, and she says he broke character and walked off with his Bible in his hand.** — A woman in the world recognized the post-up game that sisters in the body fall for. People in the world sometimes have better sense than those in the truth. - *[[1:18:14](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRCyPWIqvlE&t=4694s)]* **A graphic: 3,500 African Americans lynched between 1882 and 1968, beside 3,500 African Americans aborted every 72 hours, drawn as a noose made from the instrument used to scrape the womb.** — We pay attention to what is sensationalized rather than what is far worse, because discipline is required to change sinful habits. Nobody has the guts to say it for fear of the women who advocate for it. - *[[2:48:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRCyPWIqvlE&t=10127s)]* **A state patrol GoPro recovered from a driver filmed at 154 miles per hour directly into the sun, who lost control, hit a tree, and survived with serious injuries.** — He had tickets before and ignored them, so the consequence got harder. Surviving paralyzed, a living spirit trapped in a body that cannot move, is what a spirit in hell is like. That is what happens when you ignore the warnings the brothers and sisters give you until the ultimate judgment. - *[[2:52:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRCyPWIqvlE&t=10324s)]* **Silent traffic-camera footage of a speeding car crash in which the passenger died instantly.** — The warnings are the tickets. Ignore them and the judgment is death. ## Scriptures Opened **[Romans 13:11-14](/bible/romans/13#v11)** *[[22:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRCyPWIqvlE&t=1324s)]* > [11](/bible/romans/13#v11) And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed. > > [12](/bible/romans/13#v12) The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light. > > [13](/bible/romans/13#v13) Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying. > > [14](/bible/romans/13#v14) But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof. - Knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep, for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed. High time means the sun is at twelve o'clock and you are still asleep in your sins. - The night is far spent, the day is at hand; cast off the works of darkness, the thoughts and practices of sin you think nobody sees, and put on the armour of light. Not in rioting and drunkenness, chambering and wantonness, strife and envying, all of which is happening among certain brothers and sisters who still think this is a joke. - Put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, the commandments first, and make not provision for the flesh. Do not say you can meddle with that person, that porn, those drugs, that alcohol and stand it. Remove yourself from it or it bites you. - Deacon Yoshua's quote by way of Captain Mattathias: prophecy should move us to correction; it is not entertainment. Watch the classes of the leadership with a pencil and pad, and take notes on the breakdown, not just the verse. **[Revelation 17:3-12](/bible/revelation/17#v3)** *[[28:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRCyPWIqvlE&t=1702s)]* > [3](/bible/revelation/17#v3) So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns. > > [4](/bible/revelation/17#v4) And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication: > > [5](/bible/revelation/17#v5) And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH. > > [6](/bible/revelation/17#v6) And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration. > > [7](/bible/revelation/17#v7) And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou marvel? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns. > > [8](/bible/revelation/17#v8) The beast that thou sawest was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is. > > [9](/bible/revelation/17#v9) And here is the mind which hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth. > > [10](/bible/revelation/17#v10) And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space. > > [11](/bible/revelation/17#v11) And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition. > > [12](/bible/revelation/17#v12) And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast. - John, banished to Patmos by Rome for teaching the truth, saw a woman on a scarlet-coloured beast full of names of blasphemy. She is America, Babylon the Great, decked in pearls because she robbed everybody. The names of blasphemy are the system calling itself Christian and Jewish and demonizing the true people of God; every church is a coven of lies. - The seven heads are Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia, and Great Britain; the eighth, of the seven, is America after independence. The ten horns are the original common market, now NATO, set up to protect the beast and now swollen to thirty to try to break prophecy. - The golden cup is full of abominations: women in pants, men lying with men, women with women, and justifying the wicked while condemning the just, which this system does to the judgment we bring out of the Bible. Mystery, because the churches say Babylon is Iraq while standing inside it. The mother of harlots is this lesbian utopia and homosexual paradise where every abomination is greenhoused. - Drunken with the blood of the saints and the martyrs of Jesus. They drank our blood in captivity, and many of us will be martyred for standing on this truth up to and beyond the threat of death. - The beast that was, and is not, and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition. It was in John's vision but not in his time; it rises out of Europe, the bottomless pit, because no matter how much they dig they have no resources, which is why they rob oil, cocoa, coffee, diamonds, and gold. Perdition is what this war signifies: the weapons to burn her are already here and the Lord comes riding on them with his angels. - They that dwell on the earth whose names were not written in the book of life shall wonder when they behold the beast. They are not getting the kingdom no matter how many churches they build. Every time you say thy kingdom come, thy will be done in earth, you advocate the destruction of this kingdom, because Christ is not setting his beside it. - Five are fallen, one is (Rome, which put John on the island), the other, Britain, was not yet come and continued a short space; the sun never set on her empire until the Most High broke it with the war of independence. The preachers know this history and are financed to keep it quiet. Precepts: - **[Obadiah 1:15-17](/bible/obadiah/1#v15)** > [15](/bible/obadiah/1#v15) For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head. > > [16](/bible/obadiah/1#v16) For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the heathen drink continually, yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been. > > [17](/bible/obadiah/1#v17) But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions. The day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen; as thou hast done it shall be done unto thee. As ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, slavery, rape, robbery, rigged juries, castrations, lynchings, Rasheem Carter, Kendrick Johnson, so shall all the heathen drink continually and swallow down and be as though they had not been, reduced to nothing as they reduced us, as Isaiah 14:21 cuts off their name. But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance for those who repent; the Most High wipes out the ones who keep playing along with our enemies. - **[Isaiah 13:5](/bible/isaiah/13#v5)** > [5](/bible/isaiah/13#v5) They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even the Lord, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land. They come from a far country, the Lord and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land. The fire on Babylon is those weapons, with the two hundred million angels riding them. **[Revelation 12:17](/bible/revelation/12#v17)** *[[49:42](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRCyPWIqvlE&t=2982s)]* > [17](/bible/revelation/12#v17) And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ. - The dragon, Esau in power, was wroth with the woman, Israel of the twelve stars, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed which keep the commandments of God. That is who this government comes against, and those are the ones the Most High protects. - Be on that side rather than worrying what America will do. It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God; Esau can kill your body, but the Most High can destroy your body and put your spirit in hell. Two thirds is a lot of people, and some of that two thirds is sitting in these congregations. **[2 Corinthians 10:4-6](/bible/2-corinthians/10#v4)** *[[52:37](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRCyPWIqvlE&t=3157s)]* > [4](/bible/2-corinthians/10#v4) (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;) > > [5](/bible/2-corinthians/10#v5) Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ; > > [6](/bible/2-corinthians/10#v6) And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled. - The weapons of our warfare are not carnal but mighty through God. You are at war right now in your spirit, at home, at school, at work, and in your own thoughts, and the Lord is not asking you to pick up a gun; he is asking you to set a mark in your head to change your behaviour. - This is not advocating aggression. If someone comes with a rope or a knife, you have every right to make sure they cannot use it on anyone else, but nobody here is to initiate anything. The brother on 44th Street who got amped up at an Albanian in a trench coat, got slammed to the ground, and then blamed the elders is the example. Many of these gung-ho brothers cannot even discipline their food. - The weapons are the commandments: answer your impulses with the law and it turns you from the door of temptation. Because sentence is not executed speedily, Ecclesiastes 8:11, the wicked heart is emboldened; recognize that death is around the corner. - Mighty to the pulling down of strongholds, casting down imaginations and every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ. Open the Bible and swallow up the lies, Psalms 85:11. - Having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience when your obedience is fulfilled. Brothers want to be on the Saturday night specials casting out demons in the street, but you cannot revenge disobedience until there is no impediment to sin left in your own spirit, your household, and your children. Precepts: - **[Psalms 85:11](/bible/psalms/85#v11)** > [11](/bible/psalms/85#v11) Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven. Truth shall spring out of the earth. Opening the Bible is how the lies are swallowed up. - **[Ecclesiastes 8:11](/bible/ecclesiastes/8#v11)** > [11](/bible/ecclesiastes/8#v11) Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil. Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil. - **[2 Esdras 14:13](/bible/2-esdras/14#v13)** > [13](/bible/2-esdras/14#v13) Now therefore set thine house in order, and reprove thy people, comfort such of them as be in trouble, and now renounce corruption, Now therefore set thine house in order, and reprove thy people. Your house cannot be in order while your head is not. Check your own thoughts and temptations before correcting your wife, son, or daughter; then your obedience is fulfilled and you can revenge disobedience. **[Isaiah 46:10](/bible/isaiah/46#v10)** *[[1:17:18](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRCyPWIqvlE&t=4638s)]* > [10](/bible/isaiah/46#v10) Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure: - Declaring the end from the beginning and from ancient times the things not yet done, saying my counsel shall stand and I will do all my pleasure. Divine orchestration means God controls everything, including the people who cross your path. - Think of the people you regret meeting, who did you wrong and betrayed you. If God is the orchestrator, he sent them. We chastise ourselves asking what it was about me that let this person do this, and we miss the lesson: the Lord allows it to teach his elect something. - Betrayal is the worst thing, and most of us cannot deal with it. But the question is why God allowed it, and the answer is that the person sent to you is a reflection of yourself. **[Sirach 26:23](/bible/sirach/26#v23)** *[[1:24:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRCyPWIqvlE&t=5097s)]* > [23](/bible/sirach/26#v23) A wicked woman is given as a portion to a wicked man: but a godly woman is given to him that feareth the Lord. - A wicked woman is given as a portion to a wicked man, but a godly woman is given to him that feareth the Lord. Who gave her? The Most High. Your woman is your reflection, sent to show you what you are really dealing with inside. Let that bomb go off in your head. - Adam said the woman thou gavest me; that was to expose an impediment in his obedience. A man who complains of a wicked woman while claiming he is not wicked in his words and deeds will, if that is true, escape from her. This is about women in the world and backdoor marriages: start it wrong and it ends wrong. **[Ecclesiastes 7:26](/bible/ecclesiastes/7#v26)** *[[1:26:43](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRCyPWIqvlE&t=5203s)]* > [26](/bible/ecclesiastes/7#v26) And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her. - I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and nets and her hands as bands. Not all women, only the kind the rest of the verse describes. Some brothers live in situations worse than death: sitting in the driveway with a hot beer and the air conditioner failing, running eight scenarios before touching the doorknob. - Her heart is snares and nets: she creates chaos and assignments so you cannot get to camp, to the brothers, or to the meetings. Her hands as bands are cages to henpeck your head. - Whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her, but the sinner shall be taken by her, because she was his portion and was meant to destroy him. Some are not made to make it; if your spirit is not girded, one of these temptations takes you. Precepts: - **[Sirach 25:26](/bible/sirach/25#v26)** > [26](/bible/sirach/25#v26) If she go not as thou wouldest have her, cut her off from thy flesh, and give her a bill of divorce, and let her go. If she go not as thou wouldest have her, cut her off from thy flesh, give her a bill of divorce, and let her go. This is the worldly marriage of a man trying to repent whose wife keeps the traps going. It is not the biblical marriage: once married in this truth she is yours for life unless she commits adultery, and there is no divorce in the Bible. - **[1 Corinthians 7:15](/bible/1-corinthians/7#v15)** > [15](/bible/1-corinthians/7#v15) But if the unbelieving depart, let him depart. A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases: but God hath called us to peace. If the unbelieving depart, let him depart; a brother or sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God hath called us to peace. The bondage is the worldly marriage. When the spouse says I want nothing to do with that Bible and keeps the pork on one side of the stove, let them go. Those coming out of such situations have work to do before remarrying, and leadership holds the records; lean back when told to, because every backdoor marriage story is worse than the last. - **[1 Peter 3:1-4](/bible/1-peter/3#v1)** > [1](/bible/1-peter/3#v1) Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives; > > [2](/bible/1-peter/3#v2) While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear. > > [3](/bible/1-peter/3#v3) Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel; > > [4](/bible/1-peter/3#v4) But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price. Wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, that if any obey not the word they may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives, while they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear. A sister at a Passover panel asked when she could leave a husband of ten years who had followed her through Africanism and Islam; to him this truth is one more fad until he sees it is real. Come home disciplined, not cursing him out, dressed properly, and tell him you want him to take command. If he is righteous he comes in behind you; the same goes for a brother who repented last week and wants to turn the house upside down this week. Many wives have said, I did not know he was this serious, he was willing to let me go, and came in. The timetable is the Lord's, not your hormones. **[Exodus 34:6-9](/bible/exodus/34#v6)** *[[1:54:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRCyPWIqvlE&t=6845s)]* > [6](/bible/exodus/34#v6) And the Lord passed by before him, and proclaimed, The Lord, The Lord God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth, > > [7](/bible/exodus/34#v7) Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children’s children, unto the third and to the fourth generation. > > [8](/bible/exodus/34#v8) And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped. > > [9](/bible/exodus/34#v9) And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance. - The Lord God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, abundant in goodness and truth, keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin. That is the God we serve, and he has our back when we try to do right. - And that will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children to the third and fourth generation. He pardons, but if we keep the same bad habits we keep getting the same problems, and when the lesson is never learned the ultimate judgment comes. - Moses told the people in front of him, the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships. Not their children; thee. Their spirits came back generations later and went into that captivity, and the yokes of iron came in the 1600s, 1700s, and 1800s. It was us standing in front of Moses. Read the book of your fathers to find out what you did and why this hell is on us. - Moses bowed and said, if I have found grace, go among us, for it is a stiffnecked people, and pardon our iniquity and take us for thine inheritance. Stiffnecked then, the same hard heads today. The elect are the men and women who fit within the escape he created; do not get pulled off your game by slick talk. Precepts: - **[Exodus 20:5](/bible/exodus/20#v5)** > [5](/bible/exodus/20#v5) Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me; Visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me. Disobeying the commandments demonstrates that you hate God. - **[Exodus 20:17](/bible/exodus/20#v17)** > [17](/bible/exodus/20#v17) Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour’s. Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, wife, manservant, maidservant, ox, ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour's. Covet means to take what does not belong to you by deceit. The same covetousness from back then is still practised today. - **[Exodus 22:1-17](/bible/exodus/22#v1)** > [1](/bible/exodus/22#v1) If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep. > > [2](/bible/exodus/22#v2) If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him. > > [3](/bible/exodus/22#v3) If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft. > > [4](/bible/exodus/22#v4) If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double. > > [5](/bible/exodus/22#v5) If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man’s field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution. > > [6](/bible/exodus/22#v6) If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution. > > [7](/bible/exodus/22#v7) If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief be found, let him pay double. > > [8](/bible/exodus/22#v8) If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods. > > [9](/bible/exodus/22#v9) For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour. > > [10](/bible/exodus/22#v10) If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it: > > [11](/bible/exodus/22#v11) Then shall an oath of the Lord be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good. > > [12](/bible/exodus/22#v12) And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof. > > [13](/bible/exodus/22#v13) If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn. > > [14](/bible/exodus/22#v14) And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good. > > [15](/bible/exodus/22#v15) But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire. > > [16](/bible/exodus/22#v16) And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife. > > [17](/bible/exodus/22#v17) If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins. Steal an ox and you restore five oxen: the whole chapter restrains covetousness, like a speeding ticket raising your insurance. If a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, he coveted her behind her father's back, broke the tenth commandment, and the father can refuse him. Dinah was spoken to sweetly, not raped, and her brothers still would not give her. Get caught up in it and you bear the same sin as the one bringing the offence. ## Class Questions - **What is the point of the salute, the formations, and the marching order?** Physical discipline transcends into spiritual discipline. Resisting the itch to scratch your nose in formation trains the same tenacity that resists the impulsive itch to sin. It began in the basement in New York and is not for sensationalism. - **What did Deacon Yoshua say prophecy should do?** Prophecy should move us to correction; it is not entertainment. Watch as well as pray, and use the prophecy to get your spirit right. - **What are the seven heads, the eighth, and the ten horns of Revelation 17?** Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia, and Great Britain; America is the eighth, of the seven; the ten horns are the original common market that became NATO. - **Why does the beast ascend out of the bottomless pit?** Europe has no real resources no matter how much they dig, which is why the beast has an insatiable appetite to rob oil, cocoa, coffee, diamonds, and gold. - **What do you advocate every time you say thy kingdom come?** The destruction of this kingdom, because Christ is not setting his kingdom beside Babylon the Great. - **What are the weapons of our warfare?** The commandments of God, 2 Corinthians 10:4. Answer impulses and temptations with the law. Self-defence is your right, but nobody here initiates aggression. - **When can a man revenge all disobedience?** When his obedience is fulfilled, 2 Corinthians 10:6, meaning he has set his own head and house in order first, 2 Esdras 14:13. - **Why does God send people who betray you?** He declares the end from the beginning, Isaiah 46:10. The people you encounter are sent to reflect what is still in you so you can purge it. A wicked woman is given as a portion to a wicked man, Sirach 26:23. - **Which woman is more bitter than death?** Not all women. The one whose heart is snares and nets and whose hands are bands, Ecclesiastes 7:26, who creates chaos to keep you from the work of the Lord. Whoso pleaseth God escapes her; the sinner is taken. - **Does Sirach 25:26 allow divorce in this truth?** No. It and 1 Corinthians 7:15 apply to worldly marriages where the unbelieving spouse refuses the Bible and departs. In this truth she is yours for life unless she commits adultery. - **How should a repentant wife deal with a husband still in the world?** Be in subjection, 1 Peter 3:1-4, with chaste conversation coupled with fear, so he sees the change is real and not a fad and comes in to take command. The timetable is the Lord's. - **Who was Moses talking to when he said the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships?** Us. Their spirits came back generations later and went into that captivity. It was us standing in front of Moses, which is why we must read the book of our fathers. - **What is Exodus 22 really about?** Restraining covetousness. Enticing a maid not betrothed is coveting her behind her father's back and breaking the tenth commandment; the father can refuse. No backdoor marriages will be approved. - **Why do the same problems follow you to a new town or congregation?** You never corrected what was wrong in you, so the Lord sends the same spirits as a mirror until you learn. - **What is the narrow passage in 2 Esdras 7?** Your own lusts, temptations, doubts, and fears. The wide place is the kingdom, and nobody can pass the narrow for you because your sins are unique to you. - **How do you pass when a heresy comes into the congregation?** Stand up and say this brother or sister is bringing evil in. Get caught up in it and you bear the same sin. ## In Closing *[[2:53:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mRCyPWIqvlE&t=10386s)]* The people you encounter bring spirits, and those spirits latch onto what is still in us that needs to be purged. That is the divine orchestration and purpose of the people we encounter. The laws give you the way to escape: when you hear the heresy, stand up and name it, and you passed. Get caught up in it and you bear the same sin as the one bringing the offence.
